section_a_rowsoptionallist of Form8283SectionARow or nullSection A 'Donated Property of $5,000 or Less and Publicly Traded Securities', Part I 'Information on Donated Property' line 1 grid, rows A through E, columns (a) Name and address of the donee organization through (i) Method used to determine the fair market value. default nulltitle "Line 13 deduction for one-half of self-employment tax"
line_15_farm_optional_method_amountoptionalnumber or nullSchedule SE Part II Farm Optional Method line 15: 'Enter the smaller of: two-thirds (2/3) of gross farm income' (not less than zero) or $6,040; also include this amount on line 4b above. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
default nulltitle "Line 15 farm optional method amount"
line_16_subtract_15_from_14optionalnumber or nullPart II Nonfarm Optional Method line 16 'Subtract line 15 from line 14'. Line 14 is the fixed $6,040 maximum income for optional methods printed on the 2021 form. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
default nulltitle "Line 16 subtract line 15 from line 14"
line_17_nonfarm_optional_method_amountoptionalnumber or nullSchedule SE Part II Nonfarm Optional Method line 17: 'Enter the smaller of: two-thirds (2/3) of gross nonfarm income' (not less than zero) or the amount on line 16; also include this amount on line 4b above. Whole-dollar amount as a JSON number; null if the entry box is blank.
default nulltitle "Line 17 nonfarm optional method amount"
title "Schedule SE (Form 1040) 2021 — Self-Employment Tax"
